notes: Fixed the thin text. The Control Panel had been setting its whole window to Light (300) because of a line left over from the first design system, when the reading font was Kanit 300. It has not been Kanit for two revisions — it is Segoe UI…

Labels now have one setting instead of forty-nine. There were 49 classes doing the job of a label and five different answers to how heavy one should be, and 38 of them gave no answer at all. A design system can now set two values — one for…

Measured in the running app: 4,900 pieces of text changed weight and nothing else moved. A control pass with no change to the styling confirmed the difference was the styling and not the app drifting between runs.
